They cannot be crafted directly, instead the player must craft the corresponding [[Cast Nord Knucklechains]] and harden it in a [[Frost Foundry]]. ==Mould== '''Mould: Nord Knucklechains''' can be found: * By destroying trash piles in [[Winding Tunnels]]. * In chests buried at [[Memorial Site]]s. * By destroying weapon stands on the last floor of [[Mörkhalla]]. == Upgrading == Like most Deep North-tier weapons, Nord Knucklechains can be upgraded to one of the following two variants using essences: * {{Item link|Frostfire Knucklechains}} (with a [[Frostfire Essence]]) * {{Item link|Thunderblood Knucklechains}} (with a [[Thunderblood Essence]]) Upgraded Nord Knucklechains will '''NOT''' keep their upgrade level when it is modified using essences. {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 !Total |- !Blunt |114 |114 |114 |114 | |- !Slash |0 |8 |16 |24 | |- !Durability |400 |450 |500 |550 | |- !Crafting | [[Bloodgold]] x20

'''Liquid Frost''' is a consumable used to fuel the [[Frost Foundry]].

== Availability ==
* {{Item link|Ice|5}} can be converted to 1 Liquid Frost at a [[Frigid Kiln]] every 30 seconds.

== Usage ==
* 5 Liquid Frost can be used to fuel the [[Frost Foundry]] and harden a [[Cast]] into the final item. The hardening takes 50 seconds.
